CustomField.formula:
IF(ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c,'FR'), IF((ER_Credit_Scoring__c < 30), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_RedFlag", "",20,20), IF(( ER_Credit_Scoring__c >= 30 && ER_Credit_Scoring__c <= 70), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_Orange", "",20,20), IF(( ER_Credit_Scoring__c >= 11), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_GreenFlag", "",20,20), ''))),
IF((ER_Credit_Scoring__c <= 7), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_RedFlag", "",20,20), IF(( ER_Credit_Scoring__c >= 8 && ER_Credit_Scoring__c <= 10), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_Orange", "",20,20), IF(( ER_Credit_Scoring__c >= 11), IMAGE("/resource/BusinessRisk_GreenFlag", "",20,20), ''))) )
CustomField.label: Business Risk
